name: Rating
description: A star scale field for choosing a score, or for showing an average read-only.

label.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

description.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

error.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Not a live region.

labelPosition.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

value.description: Controlled score, shown within 0..max; 0 means unrated. Editable stars show it rounded to the nearest choice.

defaultValue.description: Uncontrolled initial score, restored by form reset. Defaults to 0.

max.description: Number of stars, an integer from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

disabled.description: Blocks choosing, focus and form submission; the score stays visible.

readOnly.description: Shows the score as a meter with its exact fraction: not editable or focusable, submitted with the form, never required.

allowHalf.description: Adds a half-star choice before each star; a read-only score keeps its exact fraction either way.

aria-label.description: Names the group when there is no visible `label`.

aria-labelledby.description: Ids of the elements that name the group; wins over `label` and `aria-label`.

form.description: Id of an external native form that owns the score.

autoFocus.description: Focuses the selected choice, else the first one, on mount.

membrane.description: Shared outer spacing around each star; toggling it keeps the native inputs.

name.description: Nonempty native form key; use a distinct name for each independent rating in a form.

required.description: Requires a score before an editable rating's form submits; ignored without a nonempty `name`.

props.label: How helpful was this answer?
props.description: Your score is shared with the author.
props.name: helpfulness

notes: Name the group with label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; description and error describe the group and every radio.
readOnly renders a meter with the exact score: no radios or tab stop, the score submitted through a hidden input, never required or invalid.
Editable mode adds native input/item parts; readOnly retains the root, list and decorative indicators.
Field owns the label, description and error parts ([data-scope="field"]) around the list.
One shared Membrane surrounds every choice; half choices retain at least 24px hit width.
The canonical 20px star glyph fills from the logical start of its ink bounds; readonly values retain exact fractions.
